description: バスの車両数、輸送人員及び走行キロ [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Data Catalog Site of the Japanese government (data.go.jp), an open data portal, published or maintained by 国土交通省. 乗合バス事業者、貸切バス事業者の車両数、輸送人員及び走行キロの経年データ. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 国土交通省. Its tags are 交通, 人の移動_ツーリズムに関する情報. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2023-06-16 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-datago-portal.
